# FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief

Capability ID: faie-signal-brief-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public URL: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/faie-signal-brief-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- research this land or water question
- investigate this agriculture signal
- give me an evidence brief on this region
- validate this environmental signal
- do a resilience investigation
- underwrite this food infrastructure site
- compare these agriculture production locations
- stress test this food production thesis
- tell me what evidence is missing before we build

## Problem

A buyer has a bounded agriculture, land, water, production, resilience, or food-infrastructure question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation that separates what is known, challenged, missing, and required next.

## Inputs

Defined question, buyer email and selected fixed offer. Geography, site candidates, asset type, crop, water source, thesis assumptions and authorized evidence may be supplied as scope context.

## Outputs

A bounded Sense-Challenge-Decide evidence packet with findings, source references, evidence-state labels, coverage gaps, adversarial challenge, evidence-acquisition queue, thesis-memory requirements and human-review items.

## Pricing

Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.

- FAIE Signal Brief: $250 (one_time)

- FAIE Proof Sprint: $2,500 (one_time)

Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout. Verified payment queues a human-controlled mission; consequential claims or actions remain review-gated.
